_doc: Storybook UI frames (D-059). Measured on the shipped PNGs in app/assets/game/ui (tools/sync_sprites.py crops them from assets/raw/ui). w/h = the PNG's pixel size (a test fails if the file changes size: re-measure then). cap_l/cap_r = columns kept at the frame's height ratio (leaves, knobs, plus button, medallion); only the middle between them stretches, so a frame is never squashed. content = the paper area [x1,y1,x2,y2] where live text may go; rects = other named areas; slots = the dock's five paper slots. All numbers are source pixels.
